role: grayscale ink retention data, multiply into merchant alpha mask

generationRecords.prompt: Create an OPAQUE black and white texture image. Full square filled with WHITE paper ground and very visible BLACK broken ink fibers and blotches. No transparency, because this is an ink-retention data map, not a faint overlay. Most of the square is bright white, about 20% covered in irregular BLACK tiny sponge pores, broken dry brush scratches and ragged fiber shapes. Hand drawn ink stamp imperfection texture for medieval sack cloth and parchment. No emblem, no letters or numbers, no object silhouette, no border. Dense irregular organic marks distributed edge to edge; strong contrast visible at 128x128. Reference is only painterly fiber style, not an object to reproduce. Important: solid white pixels are vital, do not remove white as background.

processing.channels: R=G=B=retention; A=255 data-domain coverage. White retains ink, black removes it. Do not alpha-over as a square.
processing.composition: maskAlpha*R/255; tint ink using substrate multiply, optional 1px neighbour bleed with amplitude 0.12, no white RGB compositing.

role: grayscale incised wood grain shaded height field, clipped to mark

generationRecords.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square grayscale material-only texture map for the interior of a hand-incised merchant mark on medieval oak door or barrel, compatible with supplied project's painted oak. Full-bleed 1024x1024, flat orthographic, NO symbol, no letters, no numbers, no borders, no complete wooden object, no tile-shaped cast shadow. Close painterly hand-gouged oak surface: shallow long chipped cuts and darker narrow incisions running mostly vertically, little alternating light chisel facets, imperfect grain; medium grayscale with contrasting charcoal low grooves and soft pale high ridges. These tiny grain grooves must remain legible at 128x128, approximately 2-4 pixel groove widths at final 128. This image will be clipped inside separate symbol masks, with code applying a one-pixel incised rim; do NOT draw any symbol-shaped rim yourself. Neutral gray, no color. Hand painted gouache appearance matching game reference, no photoreal crisp wood.

processing.channels: R=G=B=generated grayscale cut grain; A=255 data-domain coverage. Higher grayscale=lit facet, lower=groove.
processing.composition: Multiply substrate inside mark by 0.28+0.40*R; clipped 1px NW rim -0.24, SE rim +0.65, bounded 0.14..1.22. No marks outside source coverage. No automatic RGB rectangle.
